text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While we were holding a pre-race strategy 
meeting...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I know! If we go all *bzzzt-rat-a-tat* on 
that video, it might turn out way better!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's got busy, so no more talking about 
races! All right...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I think I'll pass for today after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo still seems so fatigued from 
the race that she can't stay focused. I 
should reconsider her upcoming race 
schedule...
